title: 행정안전부장관의 소속청장 지휘에 관한 규칙 / queue:ADDENDUM:00599:20251231:00002:part:1/1

ADDENDA (Enforcement Rules of the Organization of the Ministry of the Interior and Safety and Its Affiliated Agencies) <No. 599, December 31, 2025>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date) These Rules shall enter into force on January 1, 2026: Provided, That ... <omitted> ... Article 2 of these Addenda shall enter into force on January 2, 2026.

Article 2 (Amendment of Other Statutes and Regulations) (1) and (2) Omitted.

(3) The Rules on the Direction of Heads of Affiliated Agencies by the Minister of the Interior and Safety are partially amended as follows:

In Article 3, the term "Ministry of Economy and Finance" shall be replaced with "Ministry of Planning and Budget".
